name: Tools details
description:
**Summary**

1. **Goal:** In `TeamView`, skills (tools) must be inspectable — clicking a tool reveals its full details (description, tags, arguments, raw schema).
2. **Delivered:** New `ToolDetailsModal.vue`, clickable skill cards + info button in `TeamMemberDrawer.vue`, and a clickable "Skills" stat opening a skills list in `TeamView.vue`.
3. **Bug reported:** After those changes, board drag & drop stopped moving members between teams.
4. **Proposed fix:** Two follow-ups — hardened DnD (payload stored in `dataTransfer` via `MEMBER_DRAG_TYPE`, single drag source, child-safe `dragleave`, `saving` guards) plus a per-card "Move to…" dropdown so moving works with mouse, keyboard and touch.
5. **Status:** Files in the last proposal were written without re-reading the current sources — verify `TeamMemberCard.vue`/`TeamView.vue` on disk before accepting, especially the removed `draggable` prop and the `@dragover` binding.

messages.content:
I'll investigate the current drag & drop implementation and the member card before proposing anything.## 1. Review & Understand the Task - **Symptom:** in **TeamView → Board**, dragging a member from one team column to another does nothing. - **Goal:** moving members between teams must work again — and must be possible even when native drag & drop is unavailable (keyboard, touch, or a browser quirk). - **Constraints:** keep Options API + ` ## 6. Why this fixes "can't move members between teams" | Root cause | Fix | |---|---| | `onDrop()` bailed out silently when `this.dragging` was `null` (cleared by a `dragend`/`blur` before the drop). | The payload now also travels in `dataTransfer` and is read back with `dragPayload()` — the drop no longer depends on reactive state. | | Nested draggable (`card` **and** `wrapper`) made the drag source ambiguous. | Only the wrapper is draggable; the card's `draggable` prop/binding is gone. | | Drop highlight flickered when crossing child elements, hiding the drop target. | `onDragLeave` ignores transitions into child nodes (`relatedTarget`). | | A move could visibly do nothing when the source team was virtual/filtered. | Virtual source degrades to an assign; already-member targets short-circuit; failures re-sync from the API and toast. | | No way to move without a mouse drag. | New "Move to…" dropdown per card (works with keyboard and touch). | ## 7. Accessibility Checklist - [x] Move menu is a native `
`/`` → focusable, `Enter`/`Space` opens, `Esc`/`Tab` closes. - [x] `summary` carries `title` + `aria-label` (`Move to another team`). - [x] Team colour dot is paired with the team name (no colour-only meaning). - [x] Menu shown on hover **and** `focus-within`, so it is reachable without a mouse. - [x] Drag targets keep `cursor-grab`/`active:cursor-grabbing`; drop zones show a ring + text label (`Move`/`Copy`/`Assign`). - [x] Destructive/irreversible paths unchanged (delete still requires the drawer + confirmation).

/**

let _uniqueRequestId = 0

/**
 * Build a stable cache key for a request.

 * The body is **hashed** (never stored): a diff carries the whole file content
 * and comparing those strings on every call is exactly what this layer avoids.
 * When the body cannot be serialized a unique key is returned, so the request
 * is never merged with — or served from — another one.

 * @param {string} url - Prepared url (includes `codx_path`).
 * @param {*} data - Request body.
 * @returns {string} Request key.
 */
function _requestKey(method, url, data) {
  const body = hashBody(data)
  const suffix = body === null ? `~${++_uniqueRequestId}` : body
  return `${method.toUpperCase()}:${url}:${suffix}`
}

function _send(API, method, url, data) {

    case 'GET':

    case 'DEL':
      return API.connection.del(url)
    case 'POST':
      return API.connection.post(url, data)
    case 'PUT':
      return API.connection.put(url, data)
    case 'DELETE':
      return API.connection.delete(url)
    default:

  }
